description: Both VARMA balloons have their tails and rings in the right place, on the rider in the cream-and-gold turban with the peacock crest. But the face under the turban is drawn with Nagoji's features. He has shoulder-length CURLY black hair falling below the turban and a thick, full moustache curled up at the ends, not the sheet's straight sleek hair and thin waxed moustache. The namam, gold drop earring, necklaces and bare chest are correct. Riding beside Nagoji, who has the same face shape, moustache and curly hair, the two men read as the same face in different turbans. Checked against the 2x source frame chapters/ch10-split2/frames/page-12-panel-05-v01-2x.png. Balloon 1 shares the same ring and has the same issue.
who_the_tail_points_at: Varma (rider on the right, cream-gold turban with peacock crest), at his mouth
where_the_speaker_is: Right-centre of the panel, on horseback beside Nagoji

description: IBRAHIM's 'Marthanda Varma. And his diwan.' The ring is correctly on Ibrahim's mouth, but the drawn tail stops in Nagoji's curly hair behind his ear. Ibrahim is leaning in behind Nagoji, so at reading size the tail looks like it attaches to Nagoji's head.
where_the_speaker_is: Right of centre, turbaned and bearded, leaning in behind Nagoji's head
who_the_tail_points_at: The drawn tip ends in Nagoji's hair (back of his head); the ring is on Ibrahim's mouth

description: IBRAHIM's 'Remember what I said about gifts.' The ring is on Ibrahim's mouth, but the drawn tail ends at the back of Nagoji's neck and hair, short of Ibrahim. This is the same ambiguity as balloon 1: both tails seem to come from Nagoji.
where_the_speaker_is: Right of centre, turbaned and bearded, behind Nagoji's shoulder
who_the_tail_points_at: The drawn tip ends on Nagoji's neck and hair; the ring is on Ibrahim

description: RAMAYYAN's 'Take the Madurai horse and a hundred Maravar riders...' The long, thin tail runs straight across Varma's chin and mouth line before it ends just short of Ramayyan's face. The ring lands correctly on Ramayyan, but because the tail cuts through the seated king's face, the line could be read as Varma's in this small wide panel.
where_the_speaker_is: Standing right of the throne, bald with side curls, white shoulder cloth
who_the_tail_points_at: It ends at Ramayyan, but the tail first crosses Varma's chin and mouth

description: Both rings are on the right speakers. Ring 1 is on Nagoji (red turban, right) and ring 2 is on Dhanaji (white turban, blue coat, left). But balloon 1 sits on the left, over Dhanaji, and its tail runs right to Nagoji, while balloon 2 sits on the right and its tail runs left to Dhanaji. The two tails cross in the middle of the panel. Swapping the balloon positions would fix it.
where_the_speaker_is: Nagoji sits on the right, Dhanaji on the left
who_the_tail_points_at: Correct people, but the tails cross

description: Both rings are on the right speakers. Ring 1 is on Revathi (right) and ring 2 is on Nagoji (left). But Revathi's balloon 1 sits at bottom left under Nagoji, and Nagoji's balloon 2 sits at bottom right under Revathi, so the two long tails cross in an X. Swapping the balloon positions would fix it.
where_the_speaker_is: Revathi on the right, Nagoji on the left
who_the_tail_points_at: Correct people, but the tails cross

description: Every ring is on the right speaker. Ponnan's ring 1 is on the bare-headed rider on the right, and Nagoji's rings 2 and 3 are on the red-turbaned rider. But the tail of Ponnan's centre balloon 1 rises right to Ponnan, while Nagoji's right-hand balloon 2 sends a long tail up-left to Nagoji, so the two tails cross. A minor reading-order problem, not a wrong speaker.
where_the_speaker_is: Nagoji in the centre-left, Ponnan on the right
who_the_tail_points_at: Correct people, but the tails of balloons 1 and 2 cross

description: IBRAHIM's 'That too.' balloon sits on Nagoji's chest and its tail runs up-right, crossing Nagoji's balloon-2 tail and disappearing under balloon 2. It never visibly reaches Ibrahim, so it reads as joined to Nagoji's balloon. The ring 3 itself is correctly on Ibrahim's mouth; the visible tail is the problem.
where_the_speaker_is: Ibrahim, right rider in white turban and blue coat, mouth at upper centre-right
who_the_tail_points_at: Drawn tail ends under Nagoji's balloon 2 (ring on Ibrahim)

description: Both rings correctly sit on the king (namam, pearl drop, gold beads, white headband). He has Nagoji's thick curled handlebar moustache, not the thin waxed one, and full wavy-curly hair instead of sleek straight hair. This applies to balloons 1 and 2.
where_the_speaker_is: Varma, close-up centre, bare-chested at the map

description: The ring correctly sits on Varma (namam, pearl, headband). He again has a thick curled handlebar moustache and wavy-curly hair spilling behind the headband, both Nagoji traits rather than the king's thin waxed moustache and sleek hair.

The ring correctly sits on Varma in his cream-and-gold court turban with namam and pearl drops. His moustache is a thick curled handlebar like Nagoji's, not thin and waxed, and wavy-curly hair falls to his neck under the turban.
where_the_speaker_is: Varma, close-up left-centre in court turban

description: REVATHI (off) 'I watched from the walls...' has its tail and ring on the top-left panel edge, running just past her head. But the panel shows Revathi herself, seen from behind on the walls (cast: revathi). The (off) tag may be meant as present-day narration over a flashback. If so, a tailless caption would read better. If not, the tail should land on her head.
where_the_speaker_is: Left half of the panel: Revathi from behind, blue sari, jasmine braid, leaning on the laterite wall
who_the_tail_points_at: Top panel edge, just above and left of Revathi's head (off-panel)

description: The VARMA ring correctly sits on the bare-headed, bare-chested king on the right. He is drawn off-model toward Nagoji: loose, wavy, shoulder-length hair instead of sleek hair, a small gold ear stud (Nagoji's marker) instead of the pearl drop, and a fuller moustache than the thin waxed one. The gold necklaces, red forehead mark and side knot still identify him as the king, and Nagoji in his red turban stands apart in the same panel. So this is model drift, not a clear swap.
where_the_speaker_is: Right side: bare-headed, bare-chested man with gold necklaces holding a blue cloth

description: Balloon 1 is the PRIEST, marked (off), and the priest is not in the panel's cast. In the panel's other priest lines (p14.01, p14.04 and p14.05), the ring sits exactly on the right edge. Here the ring lands about 30px inside the panel, on the ear of a figure seen from behind in the right foreground. The drawn tail ends on the head of a grey-haired older woman in the crowd, so readers will take her as the speaker of 'For the present. For what you are to each other now.'
where_the_speaker_is: Off-panel (PRIEST (off)), presumably to the right. If the dark-haired figure seen from behind at the right edge is meant to be the priest, his face is not shown.
who_the_tail_points_at: The grey-haired older woman in a purple sari at the right of the crowd (the drawn tail tip is at her hair). The ring is on the ear of the back-view figure next to her.

description: REVATHI (off) quotes Padmini in a flashback ('She said, If you must refuse him...'). Her tail and ring go to the top edge of the panel, but Revathi is clearly visible on the right with her arms crossed, and she is in the panel's cast. The (off) tag looks deliberate, since this is present-day narration over a past scene. As drawn, though, readers see a balloon from an unseen speaker while Padmini points angrily. A tailless caption, or a tail to Revathi, would read more clearly.
where_the_speaker_is: Revathi stands visible on the right side of the panel (blue sari, arms crossed).
who_the_tail_points_at: The top edge of the panel, above and to the right of centre (an off-panel speaker).

description: NAGOJI (off) narrates over a dungeon flashback ('He tortured me. He watched while Joao...'). The tail and ring go to the top edge, while the young Nagoji is clearly visible as the seated prisoner in the middle, and nagoji is in the panel's cast. The (off) tag looks deliberate, since present-day Nagoji is narrating, but it reads as an unseen speaker. A tailless caption would be cleaner. Ramayyan's (off) reply in balloon 2 is correct at the edge.
where_the_speaker_is: Young Nagoji is visible, seated in the centre of the dungeon floor between Duarte and Joao.
who_the_tail_points_at: The top edge of the panel, upper left of centre.
